meta.title: Type Kori — Free Bangla Typing Practice & Speed Test
meta.description: Learn and practise Bangla typing free in your browser. No sign-up, no ads, and your data never leaves your device.
brand.name: Type Kori
brand.tagline: Learn Bangla typing. Free, fast, no sign-up.
practice.heading: Type here
practice.mode.systemHint: Works with a Bangla keyboard you already have installed on your computer.
practice.mode.builtinHint: Type Roman letters and the app converts them to Bangla; nothing to install.
practice.mode.builtinWarning: A native speaker has not verified this mode yet. A rule engine cannot always resolve a word-final vowel the way a dictionary does, so treat it as an experimental preview.
practice.latinWarning: Latin letters are arriving. Switch your keyboard to Bangla.
practice.osKeyboardOn: It looks like a Bangla keyboard is already on. Turn it off before using built-in mode.
practice.offlineNote: Works offline. Nothing is sent to a server.
results.heading: Results
results.definitionAccuracy: Accuracy = correct clusters ÷ total target clusters.
settings.heading: Settings
settings.dataNote: Settings and results are stored in this browser only. Export, import and reset live on the progress page.
settings.storageUnavailable: This browser cannot store settings, so they only apply to this session.
progress.trendNote: Oldest on the left, newest on the right.
progress.noMissed: No character has been missed twice yet.
progress.empty: Nothing recorded yet. Finish one practice run and it appears here.
progress.exportNote: Downloads one JSON file with your settings, history and error map. Nothing is uploaded.
progress.importNote: Reads a Type Kori backup file and replaces the data in this browser.
progress.importFailed: That file is not a Type Kori backup.
progress.resetDone: All data deleted from this browser.
progress.storageUnavailable: This browser is not storing anything, so history only lasts for this session.
lesson.failed: Not passed yet — 90% accuracy is the bar.
